Nora Fields: Hey team — MapleStack Inc (Canada) sent invoice MS-2106 for dev services billed to Redwood US but they charged 13% HST and didn't include a GST/HST registration number on the invoice. They say it's because their billing system defaults to CA rates. Should we hold payment? :confused:

Caleb Wong: For B2B cross-border services to a US entity, usually Canadian suppliers should not charge HST (export of services zero-rated) provided conditions met. If they're charging HST they must show their GST/HST registration number. Without that we shouldn't accept the tax line.

Marta Silva: Quick checklist: 1) Ask vendor to reissue invoice either (a) zero-rated export (no HST) or (b) include GST/HST registration number and correct tax breakdown. 2) Verify registration via CRA registry. 3) Confirm billing legal entity (CA entity vs CA branch of US co).

Nora Fields: I emailed them asking for either a corrected zero-rated invoice or their GST/HST registration number and proof that the supply is taxable in Canada. I said payment may be delayed until correction.

MapleStack (via email): "We billed HST because our ERP saw a Canadian billing address on file. We can reissue net, but need confirmation of receiver's tax status"

tax-bot: Note: Exports of services can be zero-rated if supply qualifies and consideration is payable in convertible foreign currency, recipient is non-resident for GST/HST, and other criteria. Also check place-of-supply rules (s. 142.1 ITA guidance). If vendor insists on charging HST, they must provide registration number — otherwise company may not be able to reclaim input tax.

Caleb Wong: Also check whether invoice mentions place of supply (e.g., 'services supplied to recipient outside Canada'). If vendor bills from a Canadian legal entity but the service is performed in Canada to a US customer, zero-rating still possible if criteria met — need vendor confirmation.

Marta Silva: If they want Redwood to 'gross-up' to cover HST, finance policy: we don't gross-up for vendor tax collection errors unless approved by finance lead. Please escalate if vendor pushes.

Nora Fields: Payment-bot set a 4-business-day follow-up.

payment-bot: Reminder set: follow up on MS-2106 in 4 business days.

Caleb Wong: If they reissue net, request a statement on the invoice like "Zero-rated - export of services" and keep evidence (email). If we accidentally pay HST and later vendor issues credit note, we'll adjust the ledger at month-end.

Marta Silva: I'll flag procurement to update vendor profile to show Redwood US as billing recipient to avoid future ERP defaults. Also will run CRA registry check once they send GST/HST number.

Nora Fields: Thanks all — holding payment and waiting for corrected invoice. Will post update when vendor replies. :white_check_mark:
